executive_summary:
The host returns from a trip to Russia and responds to the media reaction to it. She says the episode thumbnail of her with Vladimir Putin is AI-generated (A-2617.1). She also says the trip was a family vacation that she and her husband paid for themselves, that their request for a Putin interview was denied, and that she joined a family panel at the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF), which a Trump administration delegation also attended. She plays a montage of critics (A-2618.1) and reads a Laura Loomer post (A-2618.2). In the post, Loomer alleges, citing a source, that the host and her husband met Alexander Dugin in Italy, and calls for FARA registration and FinCEN flags on their bank accounts. The host denies ever meeting Dugin. She then describes a medical emergency during the trip. According to the host, an American former-military member of their security detail had a stroke on the second day and needed emergency brain surgery in a Russian hospital, after years of failing to get a VA appointment.

The host then argues that there is a historical link between radical Zionism and Russia. She cites the People's Will assassination of Tsar Alexander II, an article by Deborah Hertz on Jewish women radicals (A-2620.1), the Romanov executions under Yakov Yurovsky, and a New York Times article on Julius Hammer's financing of the Soviet Bureau and diamond smuggling into New York (A-2620.2). She shows her video from the Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood (A-2621.1) and photos from the trip (A-2621.2), and urges viewers to visit Russia.

In the second segment the host covers Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit. She plays clips of Erika Kirk being heckled as protecting pedophiles (A-2622.1), Dana Loesch reciting Bible verses on widows (A-2622.2), and Alex Clark announcing her engagement on stage (A-2622.3). She says insiders told her the summit struggled to attract young women and that female chapter leaders declined to attend. She reads Alex Clark's posts, including one asking "how did Putin taste?" (A-2623.1) and one claiming credit for prompting Trump's rant against the host (A-2623.2). She also says Clark tried to get the sponsor Paleo Valley to drop the show, and she plays clips of Clark's fiancé, Vance Voetberg (A-2623.5).

The final segment covers the video in which Charlie Kirk appears to appoint Erika Kirk to run Turning Point USA (A-2625.2). The host recaps how the video came to light and plays a supercut of Charlie Kirk's views on women and careers (A-2624.1). She says TPUSA showed the video only to Daily Mail reporters, that donors present remember Charlie saying the board would figure it out, and that his Aspen presentation mentioned Erika only once (A-2625.1). The host says she believes the clip is doctored. She reads her emailed questions to TPUSA (A-2626.1) and the reply from the TPUSA X account saying the video was real and Charlie "wasn't kidding" (A-2626.2). In the comments she says the White House asked her to narrow her FOIA request on Erika Kirk and the correspondents' dinner shooting (A-2627.1).

claims.label: Episode thumbnail of the host with Putin is AI-generated
claims.claim: The host says the photo on the episode thumbnail is AI-generated and that President Putin was not in the studio.
claims.investigative_direction: Examine the thumbnail image file and its provenance metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: The photo on our thumbnail is AI. President Putin is not, in fact, in studio today.

claims.label: Host's request for a Putin interview was denied; she has sought one for about five years
claims.claim: The host says she and her husband formally requested an interview with Vladimir Putin for the trip and were denied, and that she has been trying to interview him for about five years, including a pitch while she worked at The Daily Wire.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's interview request correspondence with the Kremlin press office and the denial.
claims.transcript_snippet: And so, we put in a formal request, and that request was denied, as it is every year. I've actually been trying to interview Vladimir Putin for like 5 years now.

claims.label: Trump administration sent a delegation to SPIEF
claims.claim: The host says the Trump administration sent an entire delegation to the same St. Petersburg International Economic Forum she attended, and that it went unreported.
claims.investigative_direction: Check SPIEF 2026 participant lists and State Department or administration records for an official US delegation.
claims.transcript_snippet: Trump administration sent an entire delegation to this same conference. Nobody reported on them.

claims.label: Host paid for the Russia trip herself and joined a SPIEF family panel on invitation
claims.claim: The host says the Russia trip was a family vacation that her family paid for, and that after extending the trip she was asked to join a SPIEF panel on family.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's travel bookings and payments and the SPIEF panel invitation correspondence.
claims.transcript_snippet: Who's pay Who's paying for We're paying for it cuz it's a family vacation. That's we pay for our own vacations.

claims.label: Commentator montage claims Putin personally asked the host to speak at SPIEF
claims.claim: In a montage of critics played by the host, one commentator says Putin himself asked the host to speak at the convention, and another says she spoke at SPIEF alongside Putin, Alexander Dugin and members of the Russian government. The host later calls the claim that Putin personally invited her a lie.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the SPIEF program and the organizers' record of who invited the host to the family panel.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, the latest is Putin himself has just asked Can- Candace Owens to speak today um at this convention.

claims.label: Laura Loomer says sources told her Dugin met the host's husband in Italy
claims.claim: The host says Laura Loomer claimed that, according to her sources, Alexander Dugin met the host's husband George in a secret meeting in Italy about a month earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Loomer for her source and compare Dugin's and George Farmer's travel records for Italy in that period.
claims.transcript_snippet: Laura Loomer who said that sources told her that Alexander Dugin, which they were all very focused on Alexander Dugin, actually met with my husband George in Italy a month ago in some secret meeting.

claims.label: Host denies ever meeting Alexander Dugin
claims.claim: The host says she has never met Alexander Dugin and did not know he was speaking at SPIEF.
claims.investigative_direction: Review SPIEF session rosters and any photographic record of the host and Dugin together.
claims.transcript_snippet: Because I've never met Alexander Dugin. We still don't know Alexander Dugin, but I would like to know Alexander Dugin. I had no idea he was speaking at this SPIEF conference.

claims.label: Loomer post called for FARA registration and FinCEN flags and tagged Treasury and Rubio
claims.claim: The host reads a Laura Loomer post saying the host should be forced to register under FARA and that her and George Farmer's bank accounts should be flagged by FinCEN, and says Loomer tagged the US Treasury and Secretary Rubio. The host says Russia did not pay for her trip.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the original Loomer post with its timestamp and tags.
claims.transcript_snippet: Candace should be forced to register with FARA. And her bank accounts and her husband George Farmer bank accounts should be flagged by FinCEN while she is in Russia.

claims.label: American security staffer collapsed on the second day in Russia
claims.claim: The host says that on their second day in Russia the family's American former-military security member collapsed at breakfast, and that their European security member suspected a stroke and urged them to call paramedics.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the paramedic call record and hospital admission record (with family consent).
claims.transcript_snippet: our American um military person had had collapsed at breakfast and he sort of said, "Look, he's okay.

claims.label: Security staffer needed emergency brain surgery for a massive clot in a Russian hospital
claims.claim: The host says the hospital told them the staffer needed immediate brain surgery for a massive clot, that he might not survive the night, and that an emergency visa had to be arranged for his wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the hospital's surgical record and the wife's emergency visa record (with consent).
claims.transcript_snippet: they informed us that he immediately was going to have to have brain surgery. That there was a massive clot in his brain.

claims.transcript_snippet: He knew something was wrong and he had been trying to get an appointment with the VA for years.
